styles.name: Porcelain Studio
styles.palette: Luminous porcelain white, pale cool gray, near-black type, a single acid-lime accent.
styles.art: Swiss editorial precision, hairline dividers, generous purposeful spacing, finely rounded panels.
styles.layout: One restrained navigation rail; a floating context command ribbon between working surfaces; a slim inspector anchored to the selected item.
styles.idea: Werkzeuge erscheinen direkt zwischen Arbeitsfläche und Ergebnis.

styles.name: Carbon Cockpit
styles.palette: Deep charcoal and graphite, crisp off-white text, electric cyan with tiny amber status accents.
styles.art: A precise professional cockpit with restrained technical typography, sharp dense panels, subtle illuminated edges.
styles.layout: A narrow vertical connection rail, a wide working stage, compact stacked telemetry on the right, a pinned bottom execution strip.
styles.idea: Aktive Verbindung, Ausführung und Telemetrie bleiben gleichzeitig sichtbar.

styles.name: Liquid Frost
styles.palette: Translucent milk-white surfaces over a very pale lilac and ice-blue gradient, violet actions.
styles.art: Sophisticated translucent material, believable frosted depth, elegant crisp typography, subtle rounded glass layers.
styles.layout: Separate floating panes with clear depth hierarchy; a compact pill-shaped app dock below; contextual tools float next to the active surface.
styles.idea: Freie Fensterflächen mit einem kompakten Werkzeugdock.

styles.name: Editorial Ledger
styles.palette: Warm ivory, ink black, restrained vermilion red, muted gray.
styles.art: Contemporary financial newspaper layout, expressive serif section titles and precise monospaced data, asymmetrical editorial composition.
styles.layout: An oversized typographic section title in a slim left column, a broad data surface, annotated margin notes and an unobtrusive toolbar.
styles.idea: Daten und technische Details erhalten die Klarheit einer redaktionellen Seite.

styles.name: Spatial Atlas
styles.palette: Midnight navy, pale cyan, soft periwinkle, measured mint accents.
styles.art: A navigable knowledge atlas with crisp planar UI, a subtle spatial canvas and elegant miniature overview map.
styles.layout: A very large relationship canvas with floating detail windows, breadcrumb path across the top and a compact minimap; no permanent conventional sidebar.
styles.idea: Datenbankobjekte werden über eine räumliche Karte erschlossen.

styles.name: Chromatic Brutalism
styles.palette: Cream white, vivid cobalt blue, signal orange, rich black.
styles.art: Refined contemporary digital brutalism, bold graphic geometry, large high-contrast typography, square corners, hard fine borders.
styles.layout: Confident asymmetrical blocks, oversized active-view label, bold tab spine and a strong lateral action band; realistic dense data within blocks.
styles.idea: Klare geometrische Blöcke und auffällige Aktionszonen.

styles.name: Zen Paper
styles.palette: Soft rice-paper white, warm stone gray, forest-green accents, dark graphite text.
styles.art: Calm Japanese-inspired minimalism expressed only through typography, spacing and subtle paper surfaces; exceptionally readable technical data.
styles.layout: A centered focused working surface with a slim collapsible outline, contextual margin rail and a single quiet primary action.
styles.idea: Ein konzentrierter Arbeitsbereich mit ausblendbarem Kontext.

styles.name: Aurora Ribbon
styles.palette: Near-black indigo, luminous violet and aqua ribbons, off-white text.
styles.art: Premium dark interface with a restrained aurora wash only in chrome, crisp solid data panels and sophisticated rounded details.
styles.layout: A continuous top workflow ribbon linking connection, exploration, execution and review; flexible working panes underneath with an active-step lens.
styles.idea: Eine durchgehende Leiste zeigt den aktuellen Schritt im Datenworkflow.

styles.name: Neo Terminal
styles.palette: Almost-black background, phosphor mint and warm amber accents, crisp bone-white type.
styles.art: A modern typographic terminal reimagined as a highly polished graphical app, fine grid rules, dense monospaced data, no retro CRT effects.
styles.layout: Keyboard-first command bar across the top, compact left object outline, split text and visualization surfaces with explicit shortcuts.
styles.idea: Tastaturbefehle sind Bestandteil der sichtbaren Oberfläche.

styles.name: Modular Bento
styles.palette: Pale silver-white, graphite, saturated ultramarine and selective lime.
styles.art: Beautiful precisely proportioned modular tiles, varied useful panel sizes, restrained soft shadows, expressive but compact typography.
styles.layout: A configurable mosaic of working modules, a large dominant main surface, small task-specific context modules and a compact top navigation.
styles.idea: Arbeitsmodule lassen sich nach Aufgabe neu zusammensetzen.

styles.name: Radial Orbit
styles.palette: Deep plum-black, lilac, peach and ivory, small cyan highlights.
styles.art: Futuristic yet credible radial wayfinding around a crisp rectangular working surface; fine arcs, restrained light and readable data.
styles.layout: A large central rectangular workbench, a thin partial orbital navigation at its perimeter, a selected-object inspector and radial context menu.
styles.idea: Werkzeuge liegen im Orbit um die aktive Arbeitsfläche.

styles.name: Clay Interface
styles.palette: Chalk-white and sand, soft terracotta, sage and dark espresso.
styles.art: Warm tactile interface with subtle ceramic depth in controls and perfectly flat readable data surfaces; graceful typography.
styles.layout: A soft recessed main working tray, tactile segmented view controls, a foldout context drawer, generous rounded but compact action buttons.
styles.idea: Taktile Bedienelemente machen Bearbeitungszustände sichtbar.

styles.name: Infrared Lab
styles.palette: Blackened burgundy, infrared coral, muted pink, bone-white text.
styles.art: Scientific data laboratory with precise visual signals, thin graph lines, compact tabular data and highly controlled luminous accents.
styles.layout: A dark precision console with vertical signal meters, a central analysis surface and a chronological diagnostic ribbon underneath.
styles.idea: Zustände und Änderungen werden wie Messsignale lesbar.

styles.name: Glass Monolith
styles.palette: Smoky graphite, translucent silver, ice-blue accents, restrained white text.
styles.art: A monolithic premium glass interface with subtly layered smoked surfaces, razor-sharp data typography and strong contrast.
styles.layout: One integrated frameless workspace, a floating navigation capsule along the left, nested translucent context slabs and a persistent bottom state rail.
styles.idea: Eine zusammenhängende Arbeitsfläche mit geschichteten Kontexten.

styles.name: Focus Strip
styles.palette: Clean white, cool gray, jet-black, vivid teal accents.
styles.art: Radically minimal productivity interface, large usable data area, exceptionally considered whitespace and precise type.
styles.layout: No fixed sidebar; a slim universal horizontal command strip, one full-width active workspace, a revealable object drawer and an inline inspector.
styles.idea: Eine universelle Befehlsleiste ersetzt die feste Sidebar.

styles.name: Ink Blueprint
styles.palette: Very pale blueprint blue, navy ink, white and sparing cobalt.
styles.art: Contemporary architectural drafting language, subtle grid backgrounds only on canvas, fine rules, engineering annotations and crisp text.
styles.layout: An object index in a thin vertical spine, a large annotated work surface, ruler-like metadata edges and a detailed selection lens.
styles.idea: Schema und Daten werden wie ein präziser technischer Plan dargestellt.

styles.name: Data Cinema
styles.palette: Velvet black, cinematic amber, slate gray, white type, muted cyan signals.
styles.art: Beautiful dark editing-suite interface with cinematic visual rhythm, horizontal time lanes, restrained metallic details.
styles.layout: A large main stage, a bottom operation-history timeline with a selected moment, a compact asset rail and an inspector on the right.
styles.idea: Eine Zeitleiste verbindet Aktionen, Ergebnisse und Datenzustände.

styles.name: Woven Canvas
styles.palette: Warm off-white, indigo, pale yellow and soft tomato accents.
styles.art: Human and inventive graph-paper canvas, crisp connected notes, typographic cards and disciplined data surfaces.
styles.layout: An infinite board where queries, results, schema snippets and notes connect by explicit labeled threads; compact floating app controls.
styles.idea: Abfragen, Daten und Notizen verbinden sich auf einer gemeinsamen Fläche.

styles.name: Magnetic Tiles
styles.palette: Deep slate, chalk-white type, electric blue, soft lilac and vivid chartreuse.
styles.art: Precision snap-to-grid working tiles, subtle depth, thin connector lines and sophisticated small controls.
styles.layout: Resizable linked panes that magnetically snap together, visible connection handles between related objects, a small layout overview and contextual action pods.
styles.idea: Verknüpfte Bereiche docken aneinander und zeigen ihre Abhängigkeiten.

styles.name: Ambient Horizon
styles.palette: Pearl white, mist-blue, soft peach sunrise tones, deep slate text and restrained azure.
styles.art: Serene near-future desktop interface, very subtle horizon lighting confined to chrome, luminous clear data planes.
styles.layout: A panoramic working surface with layered horizontal bands, a light floating universal search field, contextual edge drawers and a compact status horizon.
styles.idea: Horizontale Arbeitsbänder vermitteln Kontext und erlauben große Datenflächen.

views.name: SQL-Arbeitsplatz
views.brief: SQL workspace. Show a legible 8-line SELECT joining public.users and orders, syntax highlighting, Run query and Explain controls, result table with 8 credible rows, a 248 rows / 12 ms execution badge and a selected-row inspector.
views.labels: SQL workspace, Run query, Results, Inspector

views.name: Tabellen-Explorer
views.brief: Table explorer. Make public.users the main dense grid with 10 credible records and id, name, email, status, created_at columns. Include two filter chips, sortable headers, a selected cell, a context record inspector with type tags, and a small explicit pending-change review panel.

views.name: KI-Arbeitsplatz
views.brief: AI data workspace. Show a concise user question 'Which products grew fastest?', an assistant answer grounded in orders, a linked SQL snippet, a professional result chart, a 5-row result table, source-table chips and useful follow-up suggestions; clearly distinguish conversation, evidence and generated results.
views.labels: Ask your data, Sources, SQL, Results

views.name: ER-Diagramm
views.brief: Entity relationship diagram. Show six intelligible entity cards users, orders, order_items, products, payments, addresses with 4-6 typed fields and clear primary/foreign key markers, coherent one-to-many connectors, a selected relationship inspector and a compact minimap.

views.name: Live-Monitoring
views.brief: Database monitoring. Show a large useful query-latency line chart, a compact sessions table with pid, query, state, duration, a locks relationship visualization and a timeline of events. Use credible metrics such as 12 ms median latency and 8 active sessions, clear timestamps and subtle thresholds.

views.name: Datenvergleich
views.brief: Database comparison. Show staging and production clearly labeled, two aligned schema or data surfaces with practical tables and visible red/green changes, a selected change inspector, compact change summary and explicit review/apply actions. Use users email/status changes and one added loyalty_level column.

views.name: SQL-Notebook
views.brief: SQL notebook. Show a named analysis notebook 'Revenue exploration', a short markdown hypothesis, two real SQL cells, a result table, a clean revenue chart, execution indicators and an outline of cells. Compose the view for an analyst reading and executing the notebook.
views.labels: Notebook, Revenue exploration, Run all, Outline

views.name: Verbindungszentrale
views.brief: Connections manager. Show connections Production PostgreSQL, Staging MySQL, Local SQLite, Analytics DuckDB and Cache Redis, distinctly labeled environments. Include a selected-connection detail form with host, port, database, SSH and TLS badges, and Test connection / Connect controls. No exposed passwords.

views.name: Automatisierung
views.brief: Database automation editor. Show a comprehensible flow Trigger schedule -> SQL query -> condition -> CSV export with labeled nodes and connectors, a selected-step configuration, next-run status and a compact execution-history table with success/failure states. Use practical automation task 'Daily revenue export'.
views.labels: Automation, Daily revenue export, Steps, Run history

views.name: Object Storage
views.brief: S3 object storage explorer. Show buckets analytics and assets, a readable objects table with path, type, size and modified columns, selected parquet object with schema preview, breadcrumb and compact upload/download actions, a small storage usage visualization.

Strong hierarchy and practical information density, understated rounded panels. Show l8db wordmark, PostgreSQL production connection badge, public schema with users/orders/payments, a clearly legible 8-line SELECT query, 8 credible rows with id/name/email/status, result count 248 and timing 12 ms. Keep main labels short and clean: 'SQL workspace', 'Run query', 'Results', 'Inspector'. Crisp typography, realistic professional application UI, premium visual design. Avoid stock web dashboard templates, giant KPI cards, marketing copy, perspective, watermarks, fake 3D computers. Opaque background.

Color palette: Soft rice-paper white, warm stone gray, forest-green accents, dark graphite text.
Art direction: Calm Japanese-inspired minimalism expressed only through typography, spacing and subtle paper surfaces; exceptionally readable technical data.
